paragraphs.text: 1. GODS, whatsoe'er the Dove came hither seeking, sent to us as the envoy of Destruction,
paragraphs.original: देवाः कपोत इषितो यदिच्छन्दूतो निरृत्या इदमाजगाम ।
paragraphs.translit: devāḥ kapota iṣito yadicchandūto nirṛtyā idamājagāma |

paragraphs.text: For that let us sing hymns and make atonement. Well be it with our quadrupeds and bipeds.
paragraphs.original: तस्मा अर्चाम कृणवाम निष्कृतिं शं नो अस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे
paragraphs.translit: tasmā arcāma kṛṇavāma niṣkṛtiṃ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade

paragraphs.text: 2. Auspicious be the Dove that hath been sent us, a harmless bird, ye Gods, within our dwelling.
paragraphs.original: शिवः कपोत इषितो नो अस्त्वनागा देवाः शकुनो गृहेषु ।
paragraphs.translit: śivaḥ kapota iṣito no astvanāgā devāḥ śakuno gṛheṣu |

paragraphs.text: May Agni, Sage, be pleased with our oblation, and may the Missile borne on wings avoid us.
paragraphs.original: अग्निर्हि विप्रो जुषतां हविर्नः परि हेतिः पक्षिणी नो वृणक्तु
paragraphs.translit: agnirhi vipro juṣatāṃ havirnaḥ pari hetiḥ pakṣiṇī no vṛṇaktu

paragraphs.text: 3. Let not the Arrow that hath wings distract us: beside the fire-place, on the hearth it settles.
paragraphs.original: हेतिः पक्षिणी न दभात्यस्मानाष्ट्र्यां पदं कृणुते अग्निधाने ।
paragraphs.translit: hetiḥ pakṣiṇī na dabhātyasmānāṣṭryāṃ padaṃ kṛṇute agnidhāne |

paragraphs.text: May it bring welfare to our men and cattle: here let the Dove, ye Gods, forbear to harm us.
paragraphs.original: शं नो गोभ्यश्च पुरुषेभ्यश्चास्तु मा नो हिंसीदिह देवाः कपोतः
paragraphs.translit: śaṃ no gobhyaśca puruṣebhyaścāstu mā no hiṃsīdiha devāḥ kapotaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. The screeching of the owl is ineffective and when beside the fire the Dove hath settled,
To him who sent it hither as an envoy, to him be reverence paid, to Death, to Yama.
paragraphs.original: यस्य दूतः प्रहित एष एतत्तस्मै यमाय नमो अस्तु मृत्यवे
paragraphs.translit: yasya dūtaḥ prahita eṣa etattasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave

paragraphs.text: 5. Drive forth the Dove, chase it with holy verses: rejoicing, bring ye hither food and cattle,
paragraphs.original: ऋचा कपोतं नुदत प्रणोदमिषं मदन्तः परि गां नयध्वम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ṛcā kapotaṃ nudata praṇodamiṣaṃ madantaḥ pari gāṃ nayadhvam |

paragraphs.text: Barring the way against all grief and trouble. Let the swift bird fly forth and leave us vigour.
paragraphs.original: संयोपयन्तो दुरितानि विश्वा हित्वा न ऊर्जं प्र पतात्पतिष्ठः
paragraphs.translit: saṃyopayanto duritāni viśvā hitvā na ūrjaṃ pra patātpatiṣṭhaḥ
